practices.biological_role: Three daily doses of broccoli sprouts, blended with water and daikon sprouts and held at 37°C so myrosinase could finish forming sulforaphane, increased phase II enzyme RNA in nasal cells of healthy adults. The authors read that shared pattern as Nrf2-linked induction. They did not measure Nrf2 protein or its movement into the nucleus.
practices.limitation: This is three days of that homogenate in healthy adults and nasal enzyme RNA, not brain Nrf2, an ordinary broccoli serving, or the four-week sprout-extract capsules that did not raise lung target-gene expression in COPD.

mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Nasal target-gene response, not brain/ADHD effect, universal serving response or direct measurement of Nrf2 activation in every tissue.
